personality_one_liner: A calm, highly readable, and structured learning environment that reduces cognitive load during exam preparation.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for reading clarity; minimum 48px touch targets for all interactive elements.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Use frosted glass overlay on the primary hero/progress card over the abstract blue background
Use glass for sticky header backgrounds during Practice and Exam modes
dont's: Never blur question cards or answer options
Do not use glass on dense statistics screens

screens.name: Auth & Profile Setup
screens.purpose: Google sign-in and unique profile name creation (3-20 chars).

states.loading: Centered spinner during name uniqueness check.
states.error: Inline red helper text for taken names.

screens.layout: Clean centered logo/icon, large Google login button. After auth, transitions to a simple form with a large text input and a sticky 'Continue' button.

screens.name: Home (Нүүр)
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing overall progress and quick actions.

states.empty: No recent exams -> Show 'Take your first practice' illustration.

screens.layout: Top: Glassmorphic hero card over the abstract blue gradient showing Greeting, PRO badge, and overall completion progress bar. Middle: 2-column grid for Quick Actions (Practice Mode, Exam Mode). Bottom: List of recent exam scores.

screens.name: Categories (Бүлэг)
screens.purpose: List of 33 categories with progress tracking.
screens.layout: Vertical list of cards. Each card displays category name, question count, and a linear progress bar. From category 3 onwards, show a 'Locked' icon for Free users and gray out the card.

screens.name: Practice Mode
screens.purpose: One-by-one question learning with instant correct/wrong feedback.
screens.layout: Sticky Header: Question X/Y and an icon to open the Question Grid sheet. Scrollable Content: Optional road sign image, Question text (16px, 1.5x line height), vertical stack of 4 Answer Options (min 48px height). Below options: Explanation text (revealed after answering). Sticky Footer: 'Next Question' button.

screens.name: Exam Mode
screens.purpose: Time-pressured simulation (20 qs, 25 mins) with no instant feedback.
screens.layout: Sticky Header: Countdown timer prominently displayed (red if < 5 mins). Scrollable Content: Question text and 4 Answer Options (selected state only, no correct/wrong colors). Sticky Footer: 'Next' or 'Submit Exam' button.

screens.name: Exam Results
screens.purpose: Summary of exam performance and review of mistakes.
screens.layout: Hero section: Large score percentage (Green for pass, Red for fail). Below: Scrollable list of incorrectly answered questions showing the user's choice (red) and the correct choice (green).

screens.name: Statistics (Статистик)

states.empty: Take an exam to see stats.

screens.layout: Top: 2x2 grid of key metrics (Total answered, Correct %, Average Time, Exams passed). Below: Bar chart or list of per-category performance. Bottom: History of last 10 exams.

screens.name: Profile (Профайл)
screens.purpose: User management, PRO upgrade, and app settings.
screens.layout: Top: Large display of unique Profile Name with a 'Copy' icon button next to it. Free/PRO status pill. Middle: Action list (Edit Name, Upgrade to PRO, Light/Dark theme toggle). Bottom: Logout button (red).

instructions_to_main_agent: CYRILLIC TYPOGRAPHY: Ensure the font (Manrope) is loaded correctly. Question text MUST use `lg` (16px) font size with 1.5x line height for optimal Mongolian Cyrillic readability. Do not make the text smaller.

ANSWER OPTION COMPONENT (CRITICAL): Each option must have a minHeight of 48px. State management is strictly defined: 1) Default: surfaceSecondary bg, border outline, unfilled circle icon. 2) Selected (Exam Mode): brandTertiary bg, brandPrimary border and text, filled circle/check icon. 3) Correct (Practice): successSubtle (10% opacity success color) bg, success border, success check-circle icon. 4) Wrong (Practice): errorSubtle (10% opacity error color) bg, error border, error x-circle icon.
ICONS WITH COLOR: State colors (Correct=Green, Wrong=Red) MUST be paired with an icon change (check vs x) to be accessible. Never rely on color alone.
BOTTOM NAVIGATION: Implement exactly 5 tabs: Нүүр (Home), Бүлэг (Categories), Шалгалт (Exam), Статистик (Stats), Профайл (Profile). Use Phosphor icons (filled for active, outline for inactive).
PRO UPGRADE MODAL: Use `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` for this. The modal must clearly display the user's unique Profile Name with a one-tap Copy button, instructing them to send it to the bot.
PROGRESS BARS: Use a rounded container (`surfaceTertiary`) with an inner filled view (`brandPrimary`) representing the percentage. Use across Home and Category cards.
QUESTION GRID NAVIGATION: In Practice mode, the header should have a button that opens a bottom sheet showing a grid of numbers (1-20 or 1-total) to quickly jump to questions.
PRACTICE MODE EXPLANATION: The explanation text should appear *below* the answer options ONLY after the user has made a selection.
FREE vs PRO LOCK: In the Categories list, visually lock all categories past index 1 (the 3rd category). Gray them out (opacity 0.6) and replace the progress bar/count with a Lock icon.
